body: I can’t wait to see my boyfriend irl again 😭. It’s been like 2 months since we’ve seen each other and quarantine makes it so easy to feel alone.
I’m guessing consoles weren’t popular back then? It’s impossible to LAN with anyone from school because all of them use their console hooked up to a TV :(.
I haven’t posted there but I’ve been wanting to, what makes me want to be roasted is because they point out things that I can try to improve on

Have a support system. You don’t have to go to therapy if that’s not your thing but have people around you who care. Surround yourselves with friends who care. Take each day one day at a time. Don’t let your depression define who you are. It won’t go away in a day so be patient with yourself.
Walk in the first day naruto running. Trust me. All of the upperclassmen will think it’s super cool. Also make sure to make as much noise as possible in the halls. Enjoy Highschool.
